description: Generate 30–42 lands for a Commander within a USD purchase budget, optionally with acceleration. Supply ownedLands to buy only missing copies, lockedLands to keep specific lands, or currentLands with maxChanges for a limited upgrade. The USD budget minimum remains $20; it is a spending cap, not a target. Returns card quantities, reasoning, prices, coverage, warnings, and shopping links. Preview only: no saved build, email, purchase, or cart modification. Shopping imports match by card name; printing and final prices may differ. Always show warnings rather than describing a deficient build as optimal.

currentLands.description: Existing mana base for a limited upgrade; these copies count as owned.

lockedLands.description: Required lands to retain, including quantities. Must be legal and not excluded.

maxChanges.description: Maximum replaced land slots when currentLands is supplied.

ownedLands.description: Land copies already owned; budget and cart charge only missing quantities.

qaTest.description: Internal QA only: set true when the user explicitly says this is our test run. Excludes the call from usage/revenue statistics. Omit for normal player requests.

name: build_mana_base
